finger.line: (Bought it in a can, stirred it with my finger)
finger.linePrev: Da da da da da boom dat dat dat dat

finger.line: Everybody knows to dance, even with just one finger
stanza: From way up there, it looks so small
From way down here, it looks so small
One peculiar organism aren't we all together?
Everybody steps on ants
Everybody eats the plants
Everybody knows to dance, even with just one finger
Time takes a cigarette, puts it in your mouth
You pull on your finger
Then another finger, then cigarette
The wall to wall is calling
It lingers, then you forget

finger.line: No pinky ring around my finger
stanza: I’m nobody’s hustler
No pinky ring around my finger
But I’ve driven in my share of limousines

finger.line: But now it's rusted from the elbow to the finger
stanza: But now another stranger seems to want you to ignore his dreams
As though they were the burden of some other
O you've seen that man before, his golden arm dispatching cards
But now it's rusted from the elbow to the finger
And he wants to trade the game he plays for shelter
Yes, he wants to trade the game he knows for shelter

finger.line: I have no ring for your finger
stanza: I have no ring for your finger
I have no banquet table to lay
I have no bed of feathers
Whatever promises I made
I can't promise you fair sky above
Can't promise you kind road below
But I'll walk beside you, love
Any way the wind blows

finger.line: Death's head ring upon his finger
stanza: Everybody needs an angel
But here's that devil by my side
Death's head ring upon his finger
Poor boy hanging on the light

finger.line: A sparkling ring for every finger
stanza: I will pack all my pretty dresses
I will box up my high-heeled shoes
A sparkling ring for every finger
I'll put away and hide from view

finger.line: How many rings you got on your finger
stanza: Don't matter what you look like
Don't matter what you wear
How many rings you got on your finger
We don't care, no

linger.line: Do not ask me, love, to linger
stanza: Do not ask me, love, to linger
For you know not what to say
For duty calls your sweetheart's name again
And your heart need not be sighing
If I be among the dying
I'll be with you when the roses bloom again
